integrity: Exact symbolic Jacobian and Hurwitz determinants reproduced by an accompanying Python/SymPy checker; numerical approximations are ancillary only.
scientific_limitations: Exact local orbital spectral classification for one explicit linearly spaced growth triple, with no global basin theorem and no nonlinear secondary-orbit bifurcation theorem. Some related historical full texts were not available for complete priority inspection.
title: Sharp reactive-coupling stability transition for a heterogeneous Stuart–Landau triangle
